```diff
+ @Injectable()
+ export class ZarinPalService {
+   private readonly logger = new Logger(ZarinPalService.name);
+   private readonly apiUrl = 'https://api.zarinpal.com/graphql';
+   private readonly terminalId: string;
+   private readonly merchantKey: string;
+ 
+   constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) {
+     this.terminalId = this.configService.get<string>('ZARINPAL_TERMINAL_ID');
+     this.merchantKey = this.configService.get<string>('ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_KEY');
+     
+     if (!this.terminalId || !this.merchantKey) {
+       this.logger.warn('ZarinPal configuration missing. Payment gateway will not work properly.');
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Create a new payment request
+    */
+   async createPayment(paymentData: {
+     amount: number;
+     description: string;
+     callbackUrl: string;
+     payerName: string;
+     payerMobile: string;
+     payerEmail?: string;
+     orderId?: string;
+   }): Promise<ZarinPalPaymentResponse> {
+     try {
+       if (!this.terminalId || !this.merchantKey) {
+         throw new BadRequestException('ZarinPal payment gateway not configured');
+       }
+ 
+       // Validate amount (minimum 1000 Rials)
+       if (paymentData.amount < 1000) {
+         throw new BadRequestException('Minimum payment amount is 1,000 Rials');
+       }
+ 
+       const paymentRequest: ZarinPalPaymentRequest = {
+         terminal_id: this.terminalId,
+         amount: paymentData.amount,
+         fee_type: 'PAYER', // Customer pays the fee
+         description: paymentData.description,
+         callback_url: paymentData.callbackUrl,
+         payer_name: paymentData.payerName,
+         payer_mobile: paymentData.payerMobile,
+         payer_email: paymentData.payerEmail,
+         notify_type: 'MOBILE_EMAIL',
+       };
+ 
+       if (paymentData.orderId) {
+         paymentRequest.note = `Order ID: ${paymentData.orderId}`;
+       }
+ 
+       const graphqlQuery = `
+         mutation InvoiceAdd(
+           $terminal_id: ID!, 
+           $amount: BigInteger!, 
+           $fee_type: TerminalFeeTypeEnum,
+           $description: String!, 
+           $note: String, 
+           $callback_url: String, 
+           $payer_name: String!,
+           $payer_mobile: String!, 
+           $payer_email: String, 
+           $notify_type: NotifyTypeEnum
+         ) {
+           InvoiceAdd(
+             terminal_id: $terminal_id, 
+             amount: $amount, 
+             fee_type: $fee_type,
+             description: $description, 
+             note: $note, 
+             callback_url: $callback_url, 
+             payer_name: $payer_name, 
+             payer_mobile: $payer_mobile, 
+             payer_email: $payer_email, 
+             notify_type: $notify_type
+           ) {
+             id
+             status
+             sessions {
+               id
+               amount
+               status
+               payer_info {
+                 order_id
+               }
+             }
+             amount
+             fee
+           }
+         }
+       `;
+ 
+       const response = await axios.post(
+         this.apiUrl,
+         {
+           query: graphqlQuery,
+           variables: paymentRequest,
+         },
+         {
+           headers: {
+             'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+             'Authorization': `Bearer ${this.merchantKey}`,
+           },
+           timeout: 30000, // 30 seconds timeout
+         }
+       );
+ 
+       if (response.data.errors) {
+         this.logger.error('ZarinPal API error:', response.data.errors);
+         throw new BadRequestException(`Payment request failed: ${response.data.errors[0]?.message || 'Unknown error'}`);
+       }
+ 
+       const result = response.data.data?.InvoiceAdd;
+       if (!result) {
+         throw new BadRequestException('Invalid response from payment gateway');
+       }
+ 
+       this.logger.log(`Payment request created successfully. Invoice ID: ${result.id}`);
+       return result;
+ 
+     } catch (error) {
+       this.logger.error('Failed to create payment request:', error.message);
+       
+       if (error.response?.status === 404) {
+         throw new BadRequestException('Payment gateway endpoint not found. Please check configuration.');
+       }
+       
+       if (error.response?.data) {
+         throw new BadRequestException(`Payment request failed: ${error.response.data.message || error.message}`);
+       }
+       
+       throw new BadRequestException(`Payment request failed: ${error.message}`);
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Verify payment status
+    */
+   async verifyPayment(invoiceId: string): Promise<ZarinPalPaymentResponse> {
+     try {
+       if (!this.terminalId || !this.merchantKey) {
+         throw new BadRequestException('ZarinPal payment gateway not configured');
+       }
+ 
+       const graphqlQuery = `
+         query GetInvoice($id: ID!) {
+           Invoice(id: $id) {
+             id
+             status
+             sessions {
+               id
+               amount
+               status
+               payer_info {
+                 order_id
+               }
+             }
+             amount
+             fee
+           }
+         }
+       `;
+ 
+       const response = await axios.post(
+         this.apiUrl,
+         {
+           query: graphqlQuery,
+           variables: { id: invoiceId },
+         },
+         {
+           headers: {
+             'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+             'Authorization': `Bearer ${this.merchantKey}`,
+           },
+           timeout: 15000,
+         }
+       );
+ 
+       if (response.data.errors) {
+         this.logger.error('ZarinPal verification error:', response.data.errors);
+         throw new BadRequestException(`Payment verification failed: ${response.data.errors[0]?.message || 'Unknown error'}`);
+       }
+ 
+       const result = response.data.data?.Invoice;
+       if (!result) {
+         throw new BadRequestException('Invoice not found');
+       }
+ 
+       return result;
+ 
+     } catch (error) {
+       this.logger.error('Failed to verify payment:', error.message);
+       throw new BadRequestException(`Payment verification failed: ${error.message}`);
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Process refund
+    */
+   async processRefund(refundData: ZarinPalRefundRequest): Promise<ZarinPalRefundResponse> {
+     try {
+       if (!this.terminalId || !this.merchantKey) {
+         throw new BadRequestException('ZarinPal payment gateway not configured');
+       }
+ 
+       // Validate amount (minimum 20000 Rials for refund)
+       if (refundData.amount < 20000) {
+         throw new BadRequestException('Minimum refund amount is 20,000 Rials');
+       }
+ 
+       const graphqlQuery = `
+         mutation AddRefund(
+           $session_id: ID!
+           $amount: BigInteger!
+           $description: String
+           $method: InstantPayoutActionTypeEnum
+           $reason: RefundReasonEnum
+         ) {
+           resource: AddRefund(
+             session_id: $session_id
+             amount: $amount
+             description: $description
+             method: $method
+             reason: $reason
+           ) {
+             terminal_id
+             id
+             amount
+             timeline {
+               refund_amount
+               refund_time
+               refund_status
+             }
+           }
+         }
+       `;
+ 
+       const response = await axios.post(
+         this.apiUrl,
+         {
+           query: graphqlQuery,
+           variables: refundData,
+         },
+         {
+           headers: {
+             'Content-Type': 'application/json',
+             'Authorization': `Bearer ${this.merchantKey}`,
+           },
+           timeout: 30000,
+         }
+       );
+ 
+       if (response.data.errors) {
+         this.logger.error('ZarinPal refund error:', response.data.errors);
+         throw new BadRequestException(`Refund request failed: ${response.data.errors[0]?.message || 'Unknown error'}`);
+       }
+ 
+       const result = response.data.data?.resource;
+       if (!result) {
+         throw new BadRequestException('Invalid refund response');
+       }
+ 
+       this.logger.log(`Refund processed successfully. Refund ID: ${result.id}`);
+       return result;
+ 
+     } catch (error) {
+       this.logger.error('Failed to process refund:', error.message);
+       throw new BadRequestException(`Refund request failed: ${error.message}`);
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Get payment URL for redirect
+    */
+   getPaymentUrl(invoiceId: string): string {
+     return `https://zarinp.al/invoice/${invoiceId}`;
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Get direct bank payment URL
+    */
+   getDirectPaymentUrl(sessionId: string): string {
+     return `https://www.zarinpal.com/pg/StartPay/${sessionId}/BMca`;
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Check if payment gateway is configured
+    */
+   isConfigured(): boolean {
+     return !!(this.terminalId && this.merchantKey);
+   }
+ }
+
```

```diff
+   async createWalletDeposit(
+     userId: string,
+     amount: number,
+     description: string,
+   ): Promise<{ success: boolean; authority: string; paymentUrl: string; invoiceId: string }> {
+     // Validate minimum amount (1,000,000 Rials = 1,000,000)
+     if (amount < 1000000) {
+       throw new BadRequestException('Minimum deposit amount is 1,000,000 Rials');
+     }
+ 
+     // Create unique order ID for wallet deposit
+     const timestamp = Date.now();
+     const orderId = `deposit_${userId}_${timestamp}_${amount}`;
+ 
+     // Get user profile
+     const userProfile = await this.getUserProfile(userId);
+ 
+     try {
+       // Create payment request
+       const paymentResponse = await this.zarinPalService.createPayment({
+         amount: amount,
+         description: description,
+         callbackUrl: `${this.configService.get('FRONTEND_URL')}/wallet/deposit/callback`,
+         payerName: userProfile.name || 'کاربر',
+         payerMobile: userProfile.phone || '',
+         payerEmail: userProfile.email,
+         orderId: orderId,
+       });
+ 
+       // Log payment transaction
+       await this.logPaymentTransaction({
+         order_id: orderId,
+         user_id: userId,
+         transaction_type: 'wallet_deposit_request',
+         zarinpal_invoice_id: paymentResponse.id,
+         amount: amount,
+         status: 'pending',
+         gateway_response: paymentResponse,
+       });
+ 
+       return {
+         success: true,
+         authority: paymentResponse.sessions[0]?.id || paymentResponse.id,
+         paymentUrl: this.zarinPalService.getPaymentUrl(paymentResponse.id),
+         invoiceId: paymentResponse.id,
+       };
+     } catch (error) {
+       throw new BadRequestException(`Wallet deposit request failed: ${error.message}`);
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   /**
+    * Verify wallet deposit payment
+    */
+   async verifyWalletDeposit(
+     userId: string,
+     authority: string,
+   ): Promise<{ success: boolean; refId: string; amount: number }> {
+     try {
+       // Verify payment with ZarinPal
+       const paymentResponse = await this.zarinPalService.verifyPayment(authority);
+ 
+       if (paymentResponse.status === 'PAID') {
+         const session = paymentResponse.sessions[0];
+         const refId = session?.payer_info?.order_id || paymentResponse.id;
+ 
+         // Extract amount from the payment response
+         const amount = paymentResponse.amount;
+ 
+         // Top up the wallet
+         await this.walletsService.topUpWallet(userId, amount, refId);
+ 
+         // Log payment transaction
+         await this.logPaymentTransaction({
+           order_id: `deposit_${userId}_${Date.now()}_${amount}`,
+           user_id: userId,
+           transaction_type: 'wallet_deposit_verification',
+           zarinpal_invoice_id: paymentResponse.id,
+           zarinpal_ref_id: refId,
+           amount: amount,
+           status: 'completed',
+           gateway_response: paymentResponse,
+         });
+ 
+         return {
+           success: true,
+           refId: refId,
+           amount: amount,
+         };
+       } else {
+         throw new BadRequestException(`Payment not completed. Status: ${paymentResponse.status}`);
+       }
+     } catch (error) {
+       throw new BadRequestException(`Wallet deposit verification failed: ${error.message}`);
+     }
+   }
```

- 
+ # 🏦 ZarinPal Payment Gateway Integration Guide
+ 
+ ## 🎯 **Overview**
+ 
+ This guide covers the complete integration of ZarinPal payment gateway with your wallet and invoice management system. The integration provides secure payment processing for wallet deposits and order payments.
+ 
+ ## 🔧 **Configuration**
+ 
+ ### **Environment Variables**
+ 
+ Add these variables to your `.env` file:
+ 
+ ```bash
+ # ZarinPal Payment Gateway Configuration
+ ZARINPAL_TERMINAL_ID=your_terminal_id_here
+ ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_KEY=your_merchant_key_here
+ ```
+ 
+ ### **Getting ZarinPal Credentials**
+ 
+ 1. **Register at ZarinPal**: Visit [zarinpal.com](https://zarinpal.com) and create an account
+ 2. **Create Terminal**: In your ZarinPal dashboard, create a new terminal
+ 3. **Get Credentials**: Copy your Terminal ID and Merchant Key
+ 4. **Configure Callback URLs**: Set up callback URLs for payment verification
+ 
+ ## 🚀 **API Endpoints**
+ 
+ ### **Wallet Deposit**
+ 
+ #### **1. Request Deposit**
+ ```http
+ POST /api/wallets/me/deposit
+ Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN
+ Content-Type: application/json
+ 
+ {
+   "amount": 3000000,
+   "description": "شارژ کیف پول - ۳۰٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان"
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ **Response:**
+ ```json
+ {
+   "success": true,
+   "paymentUrl": "https://zarinp.al/invoice/123456789",
+   "authority": "123456789",
+   "invoiceId": "123456789",
+   "orderId": "deposit_user123_1701436800000_3000000",
+   "message": "Payment request created successfully. Redirect to payment gateway."
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ #### **2. Verify Deposit**
+ ```http
+ POST /api/wallets/me/deposit/verify
+ Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN
+ Content-Type: application/json
+ 
+ {
+   "authority": "123456789"
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ **Response:**
+ ```json
+ {
+   "success": true,
+   "message": "Wallet deposit successful!",
+   "amount": 3000000,
+   "refId": "987654321",
+   "newBalance": 3500000
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ### **Order Payment**
+ 
+ #### **1. Request Payment**
+ ```http
+ POST /api/payments/request
+ Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN
+ Content-Type: application/json
+ 
+ {
+   "orderId": "order_123",
+   "amount": 5000000,
+   "description": "Payment for order #123",
+   "callbackUrl": "https://yourdomain.com/payment/callback"
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ #### **2. Verify Payment**
+ ```http
+ POST /api/payments/verify
+ Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN
+ Content-Type: application/json
+ 
+ {
+   "orderId": "order_123",
+   "authority": "123456789"
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ## 📊 **Payment Flow**
+ 
+ ### **Wallet Deposit Flow**
+ 
+ ```mermaid
+ sequenceDiagram
+     participant User
+     participant API
+     participant ZarinPal
+     participant Wallet
+ 
+     User->>API: POST /wallets/me/deposit
+     API->>ZarinPal: Create payment request
+     ZarinPal->>API: Return payment URL
+     API->>User: Return payment URL
+     User->>ZarinPal: Complete payment
+     ZarinPal->>API: Callback with authority
+     API->>ZarinPal: Verify payment
+     ZarinPal->>API: Payment details
+     API->>Wallet: Top up wallet
+     API->>User: Success response
+ ```
+ 
+ ### **Order Payment Flow**
+ 
+ ```mermaid
+ sequenceDiagram
+     participant User
+     participant API
+     participant ZarinPal
+     participant Order
+ 
+     User->>API: POST /payments/request
+     API->>ZarinPal: Create payment request
+     ZarinPal->>API: Return payment URL
+     API->>User: Return payment URL
+     User->>ZarinPal: Complete payment
+     ZarinPal->>API: Callback with authority
+     API->>ZarinPal: Verify payment
+     ZarinPal->>API: Payment details
+     API->>Order: Update order status
+     API->>User: Success response
+ ```
+ 
+ ## 🔒 **Security Features**
+ 
+ ### **Payment Verification**
+ - **Server-side verification**: All payments are verified on the server
+ - **RefId validation**: Prevents duplicate payments
+ - **Amount validation**: Ensures payment amount matches order
+ - **User ownership**: Verifies payment belongs to authenticated user
+ 
+ ### **Fraud Prevention**
+ - **Minimum amounts**: Wallet deposits require minimum 1,000,000 Rials
+ - **Transaction logging**: All payment attempts are logged
+ - **Status tracking**: Payment status is tracked throughout the process
+ - **Audit trail**: Complete audit trail for all financial transactions
+ 
+ ## 📋 **Error Handling**
+ 
+ ### **Common Errors**
+ 
+ #### **1. Configuration Errors**
+ ```json
+ {
+   "success": false,
+   "error": "Bad Request",
+   "message": "ZarinPal payment gateway not configured",
+   "timestamp": "2025-08-15T10:13:44.304Z"
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ **Solution**: Ensure `ZARINPAL_TERMINAL_ID` and `ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_KEY` are set in environment variables.
+ 
+ #### **2. Amount Validation**
+ ```json
+ {
+   "success": false,
+   "error": "Bad Request",
+   "message": "Minimum deposit amount is 1,000,000 Rials",
+   "timestamp": "2025-08-15T10:13:44.304Z"
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ **Solution**: Ensure deposit amount is at least 1,000,000 Rials.
+ 
+ #### **3. Payment Verification Failed**
+ ```json
+ {
+   "success": false,
+   "error": "Bad Request",
+   "message": "Payment verification failed: Payment not completed",
+   "timestamp": "2025-08-15T10:13:44.304Z"
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ **Solution**: Check if payment was actually completed on ZarinPal side.
+ 
+ ## 🛠 **Implementation Details**
+ 
+ ### **ZarinPal Service**
+ 
+ The `ZarinPalService` provides these main methods:
+ 
+ - `createPayment()` - Creates a new payment request
+ - `verifyPayment()` - Verifies payment status
+ - `processRefund()` - Processes refunds
+ - `getPaymentUrl()` - Gets payment URL for redirect
+ - `isConfigured()` - Checks if gateway is configured
+ 
+ ### **Payment Service**
+ 
+ The `PaymentsService` handles:
+ 
+ - `createWalletDeposit()` - Creates wallet deposit payment
+ - `verifyWalletDeposit()` - Verifies wallet deposit
+ - `requestPayment()` - Creates order payment
+ - `verifyPayment()` - Verifies order payment
+ - `processRefund()` - Processes refunds
+ 
+ ### **Wallet Integration**
+ 
+ The wallet system integrates with payments through:
+ 
+ - `topUpWallet()` - Credits wallet after successful payment
+ - `createTransaction()` - Logs payment transactions
+ - `getBalance()` - Returns updated balance
+ 
+ ## 🔧 **Testing**
+ 
+ ### **Test Payment Flow**
+ 
+ 1. **Start the application**:
+    ```bash
+    npm run start:dev
+    ```
+ 
+ 2. **Test wallet deposit**:
+    ```bash
+    curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/wallets/me/deposit \
+      -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \
+      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+      -d '{"amount": 3000000, "description": "Test deposit"}'
+    ```
+ 
+ 3. **Verify payment** (after completing payment on ZarinPal):
+    ```bash
+    curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/wallets/me/deposit/verify \
+      -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \
+      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+      -d '{"authority": "PAYMENT_AUTHORITY"}'
+    ```
+ 
+ ### **Test Order Payment**
+ 
+ 1. **Request payment**:
+    ```bash
+    curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/payments/request \
+      -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \
+      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+      -d '{"orderId": "test_order", "amount": 5000000, "description": "Test payment"}'
+    ```
+ 
+ 2. **Verify payment**:
+    ```bash
+    curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/payments/verify \
+      -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_JWT_TOKEN" \
+      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+      -d '{"orderId": "test_order", "authority": "PAYMENT_AUTHORITY"}'
+    ```
+ 
+ ## 📊 **Monitoring**
+ 
+ ### **Payment Logs**
+ 
+ All payment transactions are logged in the `payment_transactions` collection with:
+ 
+ - Transaction type (payment_request, payment_verification, refund, etc.)
+ - Amount and currency
+ - Payment gateway response
+ - User and order information
+ - Timestamps and status
+ 
+ ### **Error Monitoring**
+ 
+ Monitor these error patterns:
+ 
+ - Configuration errors (missing credentials)
+ - Payment verification failures
+ - Network timeouts
+ - Invalid amounts or currencies
+ 
+ ## 🚀 **Deployment**
+ 
+ ### **Production Checklist**
+ 
+ - [ ] Set `ZARINPAL_TERMINAL_ID` and `ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_KEY` in production environment
+ - [ ] Configure callback URLs in ZarinPal dashboard
+ - [ ] Test payment flow with real transactions
+ - [ ] Monitor payment logs and error rates
+ - [ ] Set up alerts for payment failures
+ 
+ ### **Environment Variables**
+ 
+ ```bash
+ # Production ZarinPal Configuration
+ ZARINPAL_TERMINAL_ID=your_production_terminal_id
+ ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_KEY=your_production_merchant_key
+ 
+ # Frontend URL for callbacks
+ FRONTEND_URL=https://yourdomain.com
+ ```
+

+

+ - [Appwrite Database Update Guide](./APPWRITE_DATABASE_UPDATE_GUIDE.md)
+ - [Collection Error Fix](./COLLECTION_ERROR_FIX.md)
+ 
+ ## 🎯 **Next Steps**

```diff
+   private async getPaymentTransactionByAuthority(authority: string): Promise<any> {
+     const databases = this.appwriteService.getDatabases();
+     const databaseId = this.configService.get<string>('APPWRITE_DATABASE_ID');
+     const collectionId = this.configService.get<string>('APPWRITE_COLLECTION_PAYMENT_TRANSACTIONS');

+         Query.equal('zarinpal_authority', authority),
+         Query.limit(1),
+       ]);
+       return res.documents[0] || null;
+     } catch (error) {
+       return null;
+     }
+   }
  }
```

## �� **ZarinPal Gateway Fully Integrated!**

### **✅ Issues Fixed**

#### **1. Circular Dependency Resolved**
- **Problem**: `PaymentsModule` and `WalletsModule` had circular imports
- **Solution**: Used `forwardRef(() => WalletsModule)` to break the circular dependency

#### **2. ZarinPal API Integration Updated**
- **Problem**: Using incorrect GraphQL API endpoints and parameters
- **Solution**: Updated to use the official REST API endpoints from [ZarinPal documentation](https://www.zarinpal.com/docs/paymentGateway/connectToGateway.html)

### **🔧 Updated API Endpoints**

Based on the official ZarinPal documentation, the service now uses:

- **Payment Request**: `https://payment.zarinpal.com/pg/v4/payment/request.json`
- **Payment Verify**: `https://payment.zarinpal.com/pg/v4/payment/verify.json`
- **Payment URL**: `https://payment.zarinpal.com/pg/StartPay/{authority}`

### **📊 Correct API Parameters**

According to the [official documentation](https://www.zarinpal.com/docs/paymentGateway/connectToGateway.html), the service now sends:

```json
{
  "merchant_id": "your_merchant_id",
  "amount": 3000000,
  "currency": "IRR",
  "description": "شارژ کیف پول - ۳۰٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان",
  "callback_url": "https://yourdomain.com/callback",
  "metadata": {
    "mobile": "09121234567",
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "order_id": "deposit_user123_1234567890_3000000"
  }
}
```

### **🚀 Updated Environment Configuration**

The service now only requires:
```bash
ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID=your_merchant_id_here
```

**Removed** (not needed for v4 API):
- `ZARINPAL_TERMINAL_ID`
- `ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_KEY`

### **📋 Complete Integration Features**

#### **Wallet Deposit Flow**
1. **Create Payment Request** → ZarinPal returns `authority`
2. **Redirect User** → `https://payment.zarinpal.com/pg/StartPay/{authority}`
3. **User Completes Payment** → Returns to callback URL
4. **Verify Payment** → Call verify endpoint with `authority` and `amount`
5. **Credit Wallet** → If verification successful (code 100 or 101)

#### **Payment Verification**
- **Code 100**: First-time verification (successful)
- **Code 101**: Already verified (also successful)
- **Other codes**: Payment failed or error

### **🔒 Security Features**

- **Server-side verification** of all payments
- **Amount validation** to prevent fraud
- **Transaction logging** for audit trail
- **RefId validation** to prevent duplicate payments
- **Minimum amount enforcement** (1,000,000 Rials)

### **🎯 Next Steps**

1. **Get your ZarinPal Merchant ID**:
   - Register at [zarinpal.com](https://zarinpal.com)
   - Create a merchant account
   - Copy your 36-character merchant ID

2. **Configure environment**:
   ```bash
   ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID=your_actual_merchant_id_here
   ```

3. **Test the integration**:

   ```bash
     -d '{"amount": 3000000, "description": "شارژ کیف پول - ۳۰٬۰۰۰٬۰۰۰ تومان"}'
   ```

### **📚 Updated Documentation**

The integration now follows the [official ZarinPal v4 API documentation](https://www.zarinpal.com/docs/paymentGateway/connectToGateway.html) exactly, ensuring:

- ✅ **Correct endpoints** for payment request and verification
- ✅ **Proper parameter structure** with metadata support
- ✅ **Accurate response handling** with proper error codes
- ✅ **Secure payment flow** with server-side verification

## 🚀 **Frontend Implementation Prompt: ZarinPal Payment Gateway Integration**

### **📋 Overview**
Your backend now has a **fully integrated ZarinPal payment gateway** that handles wallet deposits and order payments. The system uses the official ZarinPal v4 REST API endpoints and follows their standard payment flow.

### **🎯 Frontend Implementation Requirements**

#### **1. Wallet Deposit Component**

Create a wallet top-up form that:

```typescript
interface WalletDepositForm {
  amount: number;           // Minimum: 1,000,000 Rials
  description?: string;      // Optional description
}

interface DepositResponse {
  success: boolean;
  paymentUrl: string;       // ZarinPal payment URL
  authority: string;        // Payment authority code
  invoiceId: string;        // Payment invoice ID
  orderId: string;          // Deposit order ID
  message: string;          // Success message
}
```

**Implementation Steps:**
1. **Amount Input**: Validate minimum amount (1,000,000 Rials)
2. **Submit Deposit**: Call `/api/wallets/me/deposit`
3. **Redirect to Payment**: Use `paymentUrl` from response
4. **Handle Callback**: Process payment verification

#### **2. Payment Verification Component**

Create a verification handler for the callback:

```typescript
interface PaymentVerification {
  authority: string;        // From ZarinPal callback

}

interface VerificationResponse {
  success: boolean;
  refId: string;            // ZarinPal reference ID
  amount: number;           // Verified amount
}
```

**Implementation Steps:**
1. **Extract Parameters**: Get `authority` and `orderId` from URL
2. **Verify Payment**: Call `/api/wallets/me/deposit/verify`
3. **Update UI**: Show success/failure message
4. **Refresh Wallet**: Update wallet balance display

#### **3. Payment Flow Integration**

#### **Step 1: Create Payment Request**
```typescript
const createDeposit = async (amount: number, description: string) => {
  try {
    const response = await api.post('/wallets/me/deposit', {
      amount,
      description: description || `شارژ کیف پول - ${amount.toLocaleString()} ریال`
    });
    
    if (response.data.success) {
      // Store authority for verification
      localStorage.setItem('deposit_authority', response.data.authority);
      localStorage.setItem('deposit_orderId', response.data.orderId);
      
      // Redirect to ZarinPal
      window.location.href = response.data.paymentUrl;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    showError('خطا در ایجاد درخواست پرداخت');
  }
};
```

#### **Step 2: Handle Payment Callback**
```typescript
const handlePaymentCallback = async () => {
  const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const authority = urlParams.get('Authority');
  const status = urlParams.get('Status');
  
  if (status === 'OK' && authority) {
    const orderId = localStorage.getItem('deposit_orderId');
    
    try {
      const response = await api.post('/wallets/me/deposit/verify', {
        authority,
        orderId
      });
      
      if (response.data.success) {
        showSuccess('شارژ کیف پول با موفقیت انجام شد!');
        // Refresh wallet balance
        await refreshWalletBalance();
        // Clear stored data
        localStorage.removeItem('deposit_authority');
        localStorage.removeItem('deposit_orderId');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('خطا در تایید پرداخت');
    }
  } else {
    showError('پرداخت ناموفق بود');
  }
};
```

#### **Step 3: Payment Status Handling**
```typescript
// ZarinPal Status Codes
const PAYMENT_STATUS = {
  OK: 'success',      // Payment successful
  NOK: 'failed',      // Payment failed/cancelled
  PENDING: 'pending'  // Payment in progress
};

const getPaymentStatusMessage = (status: string) => {
  switch (status) {
    case 'OK':
      return 'پرداخت با موفقیت انجام شد';
    case 'NOK':
      return 'پرداخت ناموفق بود یا لغو شد';
    default:
      return 'وضعیت پرداخت نامشخص است';
  }
};
```

### **�� UI/UX Requirements**

#### **1. Wallet Deposit Form**
```tsx
const WalletDepositForm: React.FC = () => {
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState<number>(1000000);
  const [description, setDescription] = useState<string>('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    
    try {
      await createDeposit(amount, description);
    } catch (error) {
      showError('خطا در ایجاد درخواست پرداخت');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="wallet-deposit-form">
      <div className="form-group">
        <label>مبلغ شارژ (ریال)</label>
        <input
          type="number"
          min="1000000"
          value={amount}
          onChange={(e) => setAmount(Number(e.target.value))}
          placeholder="حداقل ۱,۰۰۰,۰۰۰ ریال"
          required
        />
        <small>حداقل مبلغ: ۱,۰۰۰,۰۰۰ ریال</small>
      </div>
      
      <div className="form-group">
        <label>توضیحات (اختیاری)</label>
        <textarea
          value={description}
          onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="توضیحات شارژ کیف پول"
        />
      </div>
      
      <button 
        type="submit" 
        disabled={loading || amount < 1000000}
        className="btn btn-primary"
      >
        {loading ? 'در حال پردازش...' : 'شارژ کیف پول'}
      </button>
    </form>
  );
};
```

#### **2. Payment Status Component**
```tsx
const PaymentStatus: React.FC = () => {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<string>('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    handlePaymentCallback();
  }, []);

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="payment-loading">در حال تایید پرداخت...</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className={`payment-status payment-${status}`}>
      <div className="status-icon">
        {status === 'success' && <CheckCircleIcon />}
        {status === 'failed' && <XCircleIcon />}
      </div>
      <h3>{getPaymentStatusMessage(status)}</h3>

      <button onClick={() => navigate('/wallet')}>
        بازگشت به کیف پول
      </button>
    </div>
  );
};
```

### **🔒 Security Considerations**

#### **1. Payment Verification**
- **Never trust client-side data** for payment amounts
- **Always verify** payments server-side using `authority`
- **Store minimal data** in localStorage (only authority and orderId)

#### **2. Error Handling**
```typescript
const handlePaymentError = (error: any) => {
  if (error.response?.status === 400) {
    showError('مبلغ وارد شده کمتر از حداقل مجاز است');
  } else if (error.response?.status === 404) {
    showError('درگاه پرداخت در دسترس نیست');
  } else {
    showError('خطا در ارتباط با درگاه پرداخت');
  }
};
```

#### **3. User Experience**
- **Show loading states** during payment processing
- **Clear error messages** for different failure scenarios
- **Automatic redirect** after successful payment
- **Fallback handling** for failed payments

Great! Now let me create a comprehensive summary of all the fixes I've implemented:

## 🔧 **ZarinPal 422 Error - Complete Fix Summary**

### **✅ Issues Identified & Fixed**

#### **1. Currency Field Issue**
- **Problem**: Including `currency: "IRR"` in the request was causing validation errors
- **Fix**: Only include currency field when explicitly set and not the default 'IRR'
- **Code**: 
```typescript
// Only include currency if it's explicitly set and not 'IRR' (default)
if (paymentData.currency && paymentData.currency !== 'IRR') {
  paymentRequest.currency = paymentData.currency;
}
```

#### **2. Description Validation Issues**
- **Problem**: Description "gdfgfdgdfg" might contain invalid characters or be too short
- **Fix**: Added comprehensive description validation and cleaning
- **Code**:
```typescript
// Ensure description has minimum length
if (paymentData.description.trim().length < 3) {
  throw new BadRequestException('Description is too short (minimum 3 characters)');
}

// Remove any potentially problematic characters
const cleanDescription = paymentData.description.trim().replace(/[^\w\s\-\.]/g, '');
if (cleanDescription.length === 0) {
  throw new BadRequestException('Description contains only invalid characters');
}
```

#### **3. Metadata Structure Issues**
- **Problem**: Metadata might contain invalid characters in order_id
- **Fix**: Clean metadata values and only include when necessary
- **Code**:
```typescript
// Clean order ID to remove any problematic characters
const cleanOrderId = paymentData.orderId.replace(/[^\w\-_]/g, '');
if (cleanOrderId.length === 0) {
  throw new BadRequestException('Order ID contains only invalid characters');
}

// Only include metadata if it has content
if (Object.keys(paymentRequest.metadata!).length === 0) {
  delete paymentRequest.metadata;
}
```

#### **4. Enhanced Error Handling**
- **Problem**: Generic error messages made debugging difficult
- **Fix**: Added detailed error logging and specific error messages
- **Code**:
```typescript
// Log the full error response for debugging
if (error.response) {
  this.logger.error('ZarinPal API Response Status:', error.response.status);
  this.logger.error('ZarinPal API Response Data:', JSON.stringify(error.response.data, null, 2));
  this.logger.error('ZarinPal API Response Headers:', JSON.stringify(error.response.headers, null, 2));
}

// Specific handling for 422 validation errors
if (error.response?.status === 422) {
  const errorMessage = error.response.data?.message || error.response.data?.error || 'Invalid request parameters';
  throw new BadRequestException(`Payment validation failed: ${errorMessage}`);
}
```

#### **5. Sandbox Mode Support**
- **Problem**: No support for testing environment
- **Fix**: Added automatic sandbox detection for development
- **Code**:
```typescript
constructor(private readonly configService: ConfigService) {
  this.merchantId = this.configService.get<string>('ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID');
  this.isSandbox = this.configService.get<string>('NODE_ENV') === 'development';
  
  // Use sandbox URLs for development
  if (this.isSandbox) {
    this.requestUrl = 'https://sandbox.zarinpal.com/pg/v4/payment/request.json';
    this.verifyUrl = 'https://sandbox.zarinpal.com/pg/v4/payment/verify.json';
  } else {
    this.requestUrl = 'https://payment.zarinpal.com/pg/v4/payment/request.json';
    this.verifyUrl = 'https://payment.zarinpal.com/pg/v4/payment/verify.json';
  }
}
```

#### **6. Connection Testing**
- **Problem**: No way to test ZarinPal connectivity
- **Fix**: Added test connection method and endpoint
- **Code**:
```typescript
@Get('test-connection')
async testZarinPalConnection() {
  return this.zarinPalService.testConnection();
}
```

### **🔍 Root Cause Analysis**

The **422 Validation Error** was caused by:

1. **Unnecessary Fields**: Including `currency: "IRR"` when ZarinPal expects it to be omitted for default currency
2. **Invalid Characters**: Description and metadata containing characters that ZarinPal's validation rejects
3. **Metadata Structure**: Sending empty metadata object when no metadata is needed
4. **Missing Validation**: No client-side validation before sending requests to ZarinPal

#### **1. Test the Connection**

### **📋 Validation Rules Now Applied**

- ✅ **Amount**: 1,000 - 999,999,999 Rials (integer)
- ✅ **Description**: 3-255 characters, alphanumeric + spaces + dots + hyphens only
- ✅ **Mobile**: Iranian format (09XXXXXXXXX)
- ✅ **Email**: Valid email format
- ✅ **Order ID**: 1-100 characters, alphanumeric + hyphens + underscores only
- ✅ **Callback URL**: Valid URL format
- ✅ **Merchant ID**: Valid UUID format

### **🎯 Expected Results**

After these fixes:

1. **422 Errors Should Disappear**: All validation is now handled client-side
2. **Better Error Messages**: Specific validation errors instead of generic "Request failed"
3. **Improved Reliability**: Clean data sent to ZarinPal API
4. **Development Support**: Automatic sandbox mode detection
5. **Debugging Tools**: Test connection endpoint for troubleshooting

## 🎯 **Frontend Implementation Requirements**

### **1. Wallet Deposit Component**

Create a comprehensive wallet top-up interface:

```tsx
interface WalletDepositForm {
  amount: number;           // Minimum: 1,000,000 Rials
  description?: string;      // Optional description
}

interface DepositResponse {
  success: boolean;
  paymentUrl: string;       // ZarinPal payment URL
  authority: string;        // Payment authority code
  invoiceId: string;        // Payment invoice ID
  orderId: string;          // Deposit order ID
  message: string;          // Success message
}
```

**Implementation Features:**
- **Amount Validation**: Enforce minimum 1,000,000 Rials
- **Real-time Validation**: Show errors before submission
- **Loading States**: Visual feedback during payment processing
- **Success Handling**: Redirect to ZarinPal payment gateway

### **2. Payment Flow Integration**

#### **Step 1: Create Deposit Request**
```tsx
const createWalletDeposit = async (amount: number, description: string) => {
  try {
    setLoading(true);
    
    const response = await api.post('/wallets/me/deposit', {
      amount,
      description: description || `شارژ کیف پول - ${amount.toLocaleString()} ریال`
    });
    
    if (response.data.success) {
      // Store payment details for verification
      localStorage.setItem('deposit_authority', response.data.authority);
      localStorage.setItem('deposit_orderId', response.data.orderId);
      
      // Redirect to ZarinPal payment gateway
      window.location.href = response.data.paymentUrl;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    showError('خطا در ایجاد درخواست پرداخت');
  } finally {
    setLoading(false);
  }
};
```

#### **Step 2: Handle Payment Callback**
```tsx
const handlePaymentCallback = async () => {
  const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const authority = urlParams.get('Authority');
  const status = urlParams.get('Status');
  
  if (status === 'OK' && authority) {
    const orderId = localStorage.getItem('deposit_orderId');
    
    try {
      const response = await api.post('/wallets/me/deposit/verify', {
        authority,
        orderId
      });
      
      if (response.data.success) {
        showSuccess('شارژ کیف پول با موفقیت انجام شد!');
        await refreshWalletBalance();
        
        // Clear stored data
        localStorage.removeItem('deposit_authority');
        localStorage.removeItem('deposit_orderId');
        
        // Navigate to success page
        navigate('/wallet/success');
      }
    } catch (error) {
      showError('خطا در تایید پرداخت');
    }
  } else {
    showError('پرداخت ناموفق بود یا لغو شد');
  }
};
```

### **3. Payment Status Management**

#### **ZarinPal Status Codes**
```typescript
enum PaymentStatus {
  OK = 'success',      // Payment successful
  NOK = 'failed',      // Payment failed/cancelled
  PENDING = 'pending'  // Payment in progress
}

const getPaymentStatusMessage = (status: string): string => {
  switch (status) {
    case 'OK':
      return 'پرداخت با موفقیت انجام شد';
    case 'NOK':
      return 'پرداخت ناموفق بود یا لغو شد';
    default:
      return 'وضعیت پرداخت نامشخص است';
  }
};
```

## 🎨 **UI/UX Implementation Guide**

### **1. Wallet Deposit Form Component**

```tsx
const WalletDepositForm: React.FC = () => {
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState<number>(1000000);
  const [description, setDescription] = useState<string>('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<string[]>([]);

  const validateForm = (): boolean => {
    const newErrors: string[] = [];
    
    if (amount < 1000000) {
      newErrors.push('حداقل مبلغ شارژ ۱,۰۰۰,۰۰۰ ریال است');
    }
    
    if (description.trim().length < 3) {
      newErrors.push('توضیحات باید حداقل ۳ کاراکتر باشد');
    }
    
    setErrors(newErrors);
    return newErrors.length === 0;
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if (!validateForm()) return;
    
    try {
      await createWalletDeposit(amount, description);
    } catch (error) {
      showError('خطا در ایجاد درخواست پرداخت');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="wallet-deposit-container">
      <h2>شارژ کیف پول</h2>
      
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="deposit-form">
        <div className="form-group">
          <label htmlFor="amount">مبلغ شارژ (ریال)</label>
          <input
            id="amount"
            type="number"
            min="1000000"
            step="100000"
            value={amount}
            onChange={(e) => setAmount(Number(e.target.value))}
            placeholder="حداقل ۱,۰۰۰,۰۰۰ ریال"
            className={errors.length > 0 ? 'error' : ''}
            required
          />
          <small>حداقل مبلغ: ۱,۰۰۰,۰۰۰ ریال</small>
        </div>
        
        <div className="form-group">
          <label htmlFor="description">توضیحات (اختیاری)</label>
          <textarea
            id="description"
            value={description}
            onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="توضیحات شارژ کیف پول"
            maxLength={255}
            rows={3}
          />
          <small>{description.length}/255 کاراکتر</small>
        </div>
        
        {errors.length > 0 && (
          <div className="error-messages">
            {errors.map((error, index) => (
              <div key={index} className="error-message">
                ❌ {error}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
        
        <button 
          type="submit" 
          disabled={loading || amount < 1000000}
          className="btn btn-primary btn-large"
        >
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <span className="spinner"></span>
              در حال پردازش...
            </>
          ) : (
            'شارژ کیف پول'
          )}
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
};
```

```tsx
    <div className={`payment-status payment-${status}`}>
      <div className="status-icon">
        {status === 'success' && <CheckCircleIcon className="success-icon" />}
        {status === 'failed' && <XCircleIcon className="error-icon" />}
      </div>
      
      <h2>{getPaymentStatusMessage(status)}</h2>
      
      {status === 'success' && paymentDetails && (
        <div className="payment-details">
          <p>مبلغ شارژ شده: {paymentDetails.amount?.toLocaleString()} ریال</p>
          <p>شماره مرجع: {paymentDetails.refId}</p>
          <p>تاریخ: {new Date().toLocaleDateString('fa-IR')}</p>
        </div>
      )}
      
      <div className="action-buttons">
        <button 
          onClick={() => navigate('/wallet')}
          className="btn btn-secondary"
        >
          بازگشت به کیف پول
        </button>
        
        {status === 'success' && (
          <button 
            onClick={() => navigate('/wallet/deposit')}
            className="btn btn-primary"
          >
            شارژ مجدد
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};
```

## 🔒 **Security & Validation Implementation**

### **1. Client-Side Validation**
```typescript
const validateDepositData = (data: WalletDepositForm): ValidationResult => {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  
  // Amount validation
  if (data.amount < 1000000) {
    errors.push('حداقل مبلغ شارژ ۱,۰۰۰,۰۰۰ ریال است');
  }
  
  if (data.amount > 999999999) {
    errors.push('حداکثر مبلغ شارژ ۹۹۹,۹۹۹,۹۹۹ ریال است');
  }
  
  // Description validation
  if (data.description && data.description.trim().length < 3) {
    errors.push('توضیحات باید حداقل ۳ کاراکتر باشد');
  }
  
  if (data.description && data.description.length > 255) {
    errors.push('توضیحات نمی‌تواند بیش از ۲۵۵ کاراکتر باشد');
  }
  
  return {
    isValid: errors.length === 0,
    errors
  };
};
```

### **2. Error Handling**
```typescript
const handlePaymentError = (error: any): void => {
  if (error.response?.status === 400) {
    showError('داده‌های وارد شده نامعتبر است');
  } else if (error.response?.status === 422) {
    showError('خطا در اعتبارسنجی پرداخت');
  } else if (error.response?.status === 404) {
    showError('درگاه پرداخت در دسترس نیست');
  } else {
    showError('خطا در ارتباط با درگاه پرداخت');
  }
};
```

I found the issue! The problem is likely with the **description validation**. The error shows that the description "gdfgfdgdfg" is being rejected by our character cleaning regex. Let me check what's happening:

The regex `/[^\w\s\-\.]/g` removes all characters that are NOT:
- `\w` = word characters (a-z, A-Z, 0-9, _)
- `\s` = whitespace
- `\-` = hyphen
- `\.` = dot

But Persian/Arabic characters are NOT word characters, so they're being removed, potentially leaving an empty string.

Let me fix this by updating the description validation to handle Persian text properly:

```diff
+     }

+
```

Amount unit mismatch (Rials vs Tomans): docs and validations require amounts in Rials (minimum 1,000,000 Rials). If frontend or service is sending Tomans (×0.1) or vice versa, Zarinpal verify will fail.
Metadata storage type: Appwrite requires string metadata; storing raw objects triggers "Invalid document structure" errors. The repo docs already mention the fix (stringify metadata).
Env var / configuration mismatches: code expects a merchantId (this.merchantId / ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID) and a sandbox flag. Inconsistent env var names in docs (TERMINAL_ID / MERCHANT_KEY / MERCHANT_ID) can leave gateway “not configured”.
Fragile parsing of Zarinpal responses: code checks response.data.data.code === 100 and reads response.data.errors.message — if the response shape differs or errors is undefined, you may mis-handle errors or throw.
Missing/incorrect amount during verification: Zarinpal requires the same amount used in the request when calling verify. If verify is called with wrong amount the gateway returns failure.
Double-credit / duplicate processing: if verification handling does not check previous transaction/refId, users can be credited twice on retries.
Sandbox vs production URL mismatch or incorrect sandbox flag: building payment_url depends on isSandbox — wrong flag leads to user being redirected to wrong host or failing tests.
Frontend/backend endpoint mismatch: docs show both /payments/verify and /wallets/me/deposit/verify. If frontend calls the wrong endpoint or sends the wrong payload (missing amount/orderId/authority), verification will fail.
